title: Agent
description: An agent profile: system behaviour, model selection and tool/permission policy. Mirrors the agents entry of the Kotha configuration file.

description.description: What the agent is for; shown when picking a subagent.

model.description: Default model id in provider.model form (see model.json).

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning budget for models that support it.

system_prompt.description: System prompt, either inline text or a prompt template id.

tools.description: Allowed tool names; empty or omitted allows every tool.

permissions.description: Permission rules that apply to this agent.

subagents.description: Names of agents this agent may delegate to.
